 "claim": "Fix counters at 4 CNs: fix 1 (engine OOM fail-fast) is inert (zero OOM/futile/bad_alloc lines in any engine log of any demo-plus arm because every failure is CN-side), fix 2 is active on all six failures (24 retire lines = 6 queries x 4 CNs, all trigger=cn_err still_parked=0; the INTERNAL_ERROR cancel teardown released 663 leftover staging leases across 67 cancels, while all 48 passing runs cancel with released_leases=0), and fix 4 resolved fusion_mode=Leaf but produced zero fused lines at 4 CNs (2-4 fusions per run at 1 CN), as designed.",

  "grep -ciE 'out_of_memory|bad_alloc|OOM|futile' dp-cn4/engine-.cn{0..3}.log = 0 each; same for dp-cn1-six, dp-cn4-six-stg48, dp-cn4-q09-stg72; cnlog.txt oom_resched=0 futile=0 partial=0 on every run",
  "dp-cn4/cluster.log: 24 \"retired a query's parked sender outputs\" lines (fix2_retired: 4 per failing run in cnlog.txt), fragments 1-7 slots 1-9, still_parked=0 on all; 'skipping fragment of a retired query' 0 (1 in stg48 q09); cancel_plan_fragment lines: QUERY_FINISHED released_leases=0 on passing runs, INTERNAL_ERROR with released_leases>0 on 67 lines totalling 663 (q05 77, q08 151, q09 107, q17 49, q18 104, q21 175; values are ANSI-wrapped in the raw log, strip before grepping)",
  "dp-cn4/cluster.log 22:01:55.94 'resolved CN transport tunables ... fusion_mode=Leaf' x4; grep -c 'fused sender fragment' = 0, 'fragment fusion' = 0 (skip reasons are debug-level per fix/designs/fragment-fusion-SPEC.md:382-402); dp-cn1-six/cnlog.txt fix4_fused 4/2/2/2/3/2 for q05/q08/q09/q17/q18/q21"
 ],
 "confidence": "high",
 "impact": "Fix 2 leaves no parked GB or leases behind after a 4-CN failure; fixes 1 and 4 have nothing to act on at 4 CNs, so none of the three changes the 4-CN pass/fail or timing picture.",
 "task": "scaleout-4cn"
}
